policy.sampling: lowest SHA-256 hash per dataset, 20 each; no delta-IoU ranking inside the eligible population
policy.sample_order: Charades, ActivityNet, QVHighlights; ascending hash within each dataset
policy.eligibility: Valid greedy/oracle intervals with EOS, positive oracle@32 GT IoU gain, first divergent oracle token in original greedy top30.
policy.target_population: The 805 eligible fixed-pilot900 queries excluding the three prior extreme queries; conditional on a better saved oracle and tracked first divergence.
policy.generalization_limit: Does not estimate all 900 queries, all benchmark queries, no-improvement cases, untracked branches, other models, or natural edited videos.
policy.failures: Retain baseline replay failures, no-switch cases, nonrepeatability and decoding failures in the selected 60-query denominator.

inference_plan.primary: Fixed-budget oracle-branch reach rate and free-decoding delta IoU on all selected 60; count failures in denominator.
inference_plan.per_dataset_interval: 95% Wilson interval for binary query outcomes, n=20 per dataset.
inference_plan.paired_comparison: Gradient-minus-reverse/random query-level differences; random seeds are repeats, not independent queries; stratified video-cluster bootstrap for paired differences and mean delta IoU.
inference_plan.old_extremes: Report original pilot3 separately; do not pool its outcome-selected queries into pilot60 estimates.
